desc:
👍 First CODE at 500 LIKES!

🏀 Break ankles, win the ring and hit game-winners in RBA 27!

🏆 NEW: PLAYOFFS UPDATE - take your RBA Career through the playoffs, make the All-Star game and lift the trophy

🌐 THE STREETS - play real players online in 3v3, first to 11
⭐ RBA CAREER - create your player, get drafted and build your legacy
🏟️ 5v5 vs CPU - all 30 teams in packed arenas with live TV-style commentary
🏆 Franchise, Squad card packs, Blacktop, 3-Point and Dunk Contests

🔥 Ankle breakers, shot meter, pull-up jumpers, alley-oops and dunk packages
👟 Unlock sneakers and celebrations in the Season Pass
🎁 Free daily rewards every time you log in
📱 Play on PC, phone, tablet, Xbox and PlayStation

New? Your first game teaches you every move as you play!

👥 Join the group for free RBA Coins + the RBA MEMBER tag
👍 LIKE & ⭐ FAVOURITE so you don't miss new updates!

Unofficial fan-made game, not affiliated with any real league, team, player or game publisher.
